title: Retrieval Distillate Envelope (v1.2)
description: The single, compact, citation-bearing object a retrieval-distiller subagent returns to the main agent. Raw DB output never appears here.

topic.description: Binding question, verbatim from the main agent.

findings.description: Keep the envelope compact. Prompts soft-cap to ~15-20 top findings; 50 is a hard backstop against pathological bloat (surplus belongs in coverage.discarded).

source.description: Human source label, e.g. PubMed, Cureolex/CELLAR.

identifier.description: PMID/DOI/NCT/CELEX/URN/thesis-id etc. Provide this or url so the finding is locatable.

url.description: Resolvable URL. Provide this or identifier.

meta.description: v1.1 OPTIONAL enrichment, populated ONLY from upstream-asserted values (honesty-by-omission).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alfa-2 · ISO 3166-2 alt birim (DE-BY) · ORG:<ad> ulusüstü örgüt (ORG:WHO; ORG:AU = Afrika Birliği, AU = Avustralya) · INTL. 4.0 öncesi 'WHO'/'UK' eski takma ad olarak kabul edilir; yeni çıktı 'ORG:WHO'/'GB' yazar. Bkz. jurisdictions/_schema/supranational_codes.yaml.

id_kind.description: 4.0: akn (Akoma Ntoso FRBR IRI) · ecli · urn-lex eklendi; paket-özgü tür x-<ad> uzantı ad alanıyla (paket belgesinde tanımlanır).

verified_against.description: Identifier whose fetched body grounded this finding.

as_of_date.description: in-force as-of date used for the currency check.

passes.description: v1.1: number of search/gap passes the loop ran.

source_status.description: v1.1 OPTIONAL structured mirror of empty_or_failed; the string[] stays authoritative for compact display.

distiller_note.description: What was dropped & why; domain caveats. No silent loss.

comparative.description: v1.1 OPTIONAL; populated only when kept findings span >=2 jurisdictions. Asserts nothing not already in findings[]; cites existing [E#] only.
